items.name: Dawnfin
items.description: A small warm-scaled pond fish.

items.name: Mosscarp
items.description: Placid and green; naps between reeds.

items.name: Glimmerling
items.description: It carries a fleck of sunset in its tail.

items.name: Reeds
items.description: Bendy, useful, everywhere near water.

items.name: Driftwood
items.description: Water-smoothed timber.

items.name: Shell
items.description: A spiral home someone outgrew.

items.name: Smooth Stone
items.description: Round as a promise.

items.name: Land Fragment
items.description: A living mote of world. Enough of these become a place.

items.name: Softwood
items.description: Grove timber, light and kind to tools.

items.name: Hardwood
items.description: Dense heartwood from a well-tended grove.

items.name: Resin
items.description: Golden and slow, like the grove is thinking.

items.name: Seedwood
items.description: A branch that wants to be a forest.

items.name: Old Metal
items.description: Ruined fittings, still strong under the rust.

items.name: Carved Stone
items.description: Someone shaped this long ago.

items.name: Relic Fragment
items.description: A piece of the watchpost's story.

items.name: Pattern Dust
items.description: Duplicate discoveries settle into this. Spend it to steer the next reveal.

items.name: Wild Land Parcel
items.description: An unclaimed piece of world. Open it to choose what it becomes.

items.name: Meadow Parcel
items.description: Warm open land, ready for paths and gardens.

items.name: Grove Parcel
items.description: Land that arrives already dreaming of trees.

items.name: Stone Parcel
items.description: Old bones of the world, good for ruins and roads.

items.name: Winter Parcel
items.description: A cool piece of world carrying snow, frost, and quiet paths.

items.name: Willow Rod
items.description: Your first rod. It has caught everything you own.

items.name: Keeper's Axe
items.description: Honest iron on honest wood.

items.name: Fine Axe
items.description: Gold-edged and eager. Groves respect it.

items.name: Thornsplitter
items.description: Short, bright, and enough.

items.name: Explorer's Hood
items.description: Smells faintly of pine and far away.

items.name: Explorer's Tunic
items.description: Reinforced for brambles and weather. (Recolors your tunic.)

items.name: Cowboy Vest
items.description: A fitted frontier vest. Skinned to the keeper's shared wardrobe rig.

items.name: Watchpost Cape
items.description: Woven from the ivy that held the tower together. The guardian's gift.

items.name: Watch Emblem
items.description: The old garrison's sigil, polished new.
